title: 2024年12月四级真题 第3套 阅读2
paperTitle: 2024年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
passage:
P1 Do you ever blend up a protein drink for breakfast, or grab a protein bar following an afternoon workout? If so, you are likely among the millions of people in search of more protein-rich diets.

P2 Protein-enriched products are found everywhere. But contrary to all the publicity that everyone needs more protein, most Americans get twice as much as they need.

P3 Many of us living in the most developed countries are buying into a myth of protein deficiency created by food companies and self-identified health experts. Global retail sales of protein supplement products reached an astonishing US$18.9 billion in 2020.

P4 But are we really in need of more protein? Physicians in the U.S. have never actually examined a patient with protein deficiency because simply by eating an adequate number of daily calories we are also most likely getting enough protein.

P5 In fact, Americans currently consume almost twice the National Academy of Medicine's recommended daily intake of protein although the most desirable protein intake may vary depending on age and activity level.

P6 For example, if you're a dedicated athlete you might need to consume higher quantities of protein. Generally, though, a 140-pound person should not exceed 120 grams of protein per day, particularly because a high protein diet can strain kidney and liver function and increase risks of developing heart disease and cancer.

P7 While fats and sugar have taken the beating in turns since over a century ago, protein has managed to remain our red-hot favorite.

P8 In the 1970s through the 1990s, protein products remained visible but moved back somewhat with the dietary spotlight firmly fixed on low-calorie, low-fat, sugar-free snack foods and beverages following the publication of studies linking sugar and saturated(饱和的) fat consumption to heart disease.

P9 Later research in 2003, however, suggested high-protein diets could aid in weight loss, and protein quickly regained its former nutrient-superstar status.

P10 Now most people living in high-income nations are consuming enough protein. When we replace meals with a protein bar or drink, we also risk missing out on the rich sources of antioxidants(抗氧化剂), vitamins and many other benefits of real food.

questions.q: What do we learn about publicity over protein in America?
options: It has helped to create the myth of protein deficiency.
It has helped Americans in search of protein-rich diets.
It has raised a lot of health concerns among the public.
It has been funded by food companies and health experts.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do we learn about publicity over protein in America? 是一个 What…learn about 的事实型问句，直接问关于某对象（publicity）的某一事实，没有 infer/suggest/imply 等推断信号。

【拆句】句式平铺直叙：What do we learn about publicity over protein in America? 主干是 What do we learn about X，介词短语 over protein 是 publicity 的范围限定，in America 限定地域，无陷阱。

【定位】Many of us living in the most developed countries are buying into a myth of protein deficiency created by food companies and self-identified health experts. 我们这些生活在大多数发达国家的人，正在接受一个由食品公司和自封的健康专家制造出来 的"蛋白质缺乏"神话。 51. What do we learn about publicity over protein in America? A) It has helped to create the myth of protein deficiency. B) It has helped Americans in search of protein-rich diets. C) It has raised a lot of health concerns among the public. D) It has been funded by food companies and health experts.

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 buying into a myth of protein deficiency created by food companies and self-identified health experts ↔It has helped to create the myth of protein deficiency. contrary to all the publicity that everyone needs more protein ↔ the myth of protein deficiency 预判说"宣传促成了蛋白缺乏的迷思"，helped to create the myth of protein deficiency 一字不差地落到这个语义上，是定位句的直接同义替换。 B) 与原文相反 原文用 buying into a myth 表明宣传是在"骗"美国人，并非"帮"他们；选项 helped Americans in search of protein-rich diets 把负面后果包装成正面服务，与原作者态度 相反。 C) 无中生有 原文从未说 publicity "raised health concerns"——P6 的健康风险讲的是高蛋白饮食 本身，而非舆论造成的恐慌；选项 raised a lot of health concerns among the public 在文中无落点。 D) 偷换概念 原文说迷思是 created by food companies and self-identified health experts，主语 是"食品公司和自封专家"在制造迷思；选项 funded by food companies and health experts 把 created 偷换成 funded（资助），且把 publicity 当受资助对象，主体与动 作都被改写。 为什么美国医生从未真正诊治过蛋白质缺乏症患者? A) 美国人可以在各处购买到多种富含蛋白质的食品。 B) 美国人能够摄入食品专家推荐的卡路里量。 C) 美国人只需每天摄入足够的食物就能获得充足的蛋白质。 D) 美国人可以依靠食品补充剂来预防蛋白质缺乏。

questions.q: Why have physicians in the U.S. never actually examined a patient with protein deficiency?
options: Americans can purchase many kinds of protein-rich foods everywhere.
Americans can absorb the number of calories recommended by food experts.
Americans can get sufficient protein just by eating adequate foods daily.
Americans can rely on food supplements to prevent protein deficiency.
questions.explain:
【判型】Why have physicians in the U.S. never actually examined a patient with protein deficiency? 用 Why 直问原因，要求按原文给出的解释作答，不需要自行推断。

【拆句】现在完成时 have…never actually examined，never 是关键否定词，actually 加强语气， 提示原文给出的解释是"压根没机会见到"层面的原因；理解时把 never examined 当作"从 未见过"即可。 52. Why have physicians in the U.S. never actually examined a patient with protein deficiency? A) Americans can purchase many kinds of protein-rich foods everywhere. B) Americans can absorb the number of calories recommended by food experts. C) Americans can get sufficient protein just by eating adequate foods daily. D) Americans can rely on food supplements to prevent protein deficiency.

【定位】Physicians in the U.S. have never actually examined a patient with protein deficiency because simply by eating an adequate number of daily calories we are also most likely getting enough protein. 美国医生从未真正诊治过蛋白缺乏的病人，因为只要每天摄入足够的卡路里，我们也就极可 能获得了足够的蛋白质。

【选项】A) 答非所问 原文给出的原因是"日常热量摄入足够蛋白也就够了"，与"能否买到"无关；选项 purchase many kinds of protein-rich foods everywhere 谈购买便利性，是另一 回事。 B) 偷换概念 原文说的是 an adequate number of daily calories"日常足量的卡路里"，选项 absorb the number of calories recommended by food experts 偷换为"食品专家推荐的卡路 里数"——多了"food experts recommended"这一未出现的限定，且 absorb 与 eating 含义偏移。 C) ✓ 正确 simply by eating an adequate number of daily calories we are also most likely getting enough protein ↔Americans can get sufficient protein just by eating adequate foods daily. 预判说"靠正常饮食的热量就够蛋白"，get sufficient protein just by eating adequate foods daily 几乎逐字对应，是 because 句的同义替换。 D) 与原文相反 原文的因果是"正常饮食就够蛋白，所以不必靠补剂"；选项 rely on food supplements to prevent protein deficiency 反过来说"靠补剂预防缺乏"，正是全文批判的对象。 人们在决定最理想的蛋白质摄入量时应考虑什么? A) 他们有多健康以及他们吃什么食物。 B) 他们的年龄以及他们从事什么活动。 C) 他们摄入多少蛋白质以及他们的体重是多少。 D) 他们的蛋白质缺乏有多严重以及他们使用什么补救措施。

questions.q: What should people take into consideration in deciding on the most preferable protein intake?
options: How healthy they are and what food they eat.
How old they are and what activities they do.
How much protein they consume and what their body weight is.
How serious their protein deficiency is and what remedies they use.
questions.explain:
【判型】What should people take into consideration in deciding on the most preferable protein intake? 在问决策依据，原文必会以并列形式给出依据项，照搬即可。

【拆句】in deciding on… 是 in doing 结构作状语，表"在做某事的时候"；主干是 What should people take into consideration，把状语剥掉，问句就回归"应考虑什么"，简单。 53. What should people take into consideration in deciding on the most preferable protein intake? A) How healthy they are and what food they eat. B) How old they are and what activities they do. C) How much protein they consume and what their body weight is. D) How serious their protein deficiency is and what remedies they use.

【定位】Americans currently consume almost twice the National Academy of Medicine's recommended daily intake of protein although the most desirable protein intake may vary depending on age and activity level. 尽管最理想的蛋白摄入量可能因年龄和活动量不同而有所差异，美国人现在的蛋白摄入仍接 近美国医学科学院推荐摄入量的两倍。

【选项】A) 无中生有 原文只列了 age and activity level，并未把"现在健康程度"或"吃什么食物"列入考虑因 素；选项 How healthy they are and what food they eat 是凭常识自造的因素。 B) ✓ 正确 depending on age and activity level ↔How old they are and what activities they do. 预判的"年龄+活动量"两项，与 How old they are and what activities they do 一一对 齐，是最直接的同义替换。 C) 偷换概念 原文要讨论的是"理想蛋白摄入量"本身，选项 How much protein they consume and what their body weight is 反过来把"已经摄入多少蛋白"和"体重"作为考量因素，循 环定义且无文本依据；P6 提到 140-pound 只是举例上限，并非"决定理想摄入量的 因素"。 D) 与原文相反 选项 How serious their protein deficiency is and what remedies they use 默认存 在"protein deficiency"，但原文 P4 明确说美国医生从未见过蛋白缺乏患者，根本不存 在这样的前提。 哪些食物在一个多世纪以来基本上不受欢迎? A) 无糖零食。 B) 富含蛋白质的食物。 C) 红肉和白肉。 D) 含糖和高脂肪食物。

questions.q: What foods have been largely out of favor for more than a century?
options: Sugar-free snacks.
Protein-rich foods.
Both red and white meats.
Sugary and fatty foods.
questions.explain:
【判型】What foods have been largely out of favor for more than a century? 是事实型问句， 答案就在原文某句的事实陈述里。

【拆句】现在完成时 have been largely out of favor 表过去到现在的持续状态；largely 是程度副 词，表"在很大程度上"，提醒不要选"完全/彻底"等绝对化误读。

【定位】While fats and sugar have taken the beating in turns since over a century ago, protein has managed to remain our red-hot favorite. 一个多世纪以来，脂肪和糖轮流挨批，而蛋白质却始终是我们的红人。 54. What foods have been largely out of favor for more than a century? A) Sugar-free snacks. B) Protein-rich foods. C) Both red and white meats. D) Sugary and fatty foods.

【选项】A) 与原文相反 原文 dietary spotlight firmly fixed on low-calorie, low-fat, sugar-free snack foods 说"无糖零食"是 1970-90 年代受追捧的对象，不是被嫌弃的对象；选项 Sugar-free snacks 把追捧对象当成 out of favor，颠倒立场。 B) 与原文相反 原文 protein has managed to remain our red-hot favorite 明说蛋白质始终是 favorite（红人），选项 Protein-rich foods 反过来说它失宠，180 度反向。 C) 无中生有 原文 P7-P9 整段都在讲脂肪、糖和蛋白质这几类宏量营养素，从未提到"红肉/白肉"被批 的话题；选项 Both red and white meats 是凭健康常识填空。 D) ✓ 正确 fats and sugar ↔Sugary and fatty foods. taken the beating in turns since over a century ago ↔ largely out of favor for more than a century 预判"脂肪和糖被批了一百多年"，Sugary and fatty foods 对齐对象，题干本身对齐时 间与态度，三要素全合。 作者暗示发达国家的人们应该做什么来保持健康? A) 享用天然食物。 B) 吃素食。 C) 每天摄入足够的蛋白质。 D) 用蛋白质棒代替正餐。

questions.q: What does the author imply people in developed countries should do to keep healthy?
options: Enjoy natural food.
Eat vegetarian diets.
Consume enough protein daily.
Replace meals with protein bars.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author imply people in developed countries should do to keep healthy? 题干直接用 imply，是推断题的标准句式。

【拆句】句式较长但分层清晰：主干 What does the author imply X should do，宾语从句的主语 是 people in developed countries，目的状语 to keep healthy；抓住"作者+暗示+发达 国家民众+保持健康"四要素即可。 55. What does the author imply people in developed countries should do to keep healthy? A) Enjoy natural food. B) Eat vegetarian diets. C) Consume enough protein daily. D) Replace meals with protein bars.

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 rich sources of antioxidants(抗氧化剂), vitamins and many other benefits of real food ↔ Enjoy natural food. When we replace meals with a protein bar or drink, we also risk missing out on… ↔ Enjoy natural food. 预判作者推荐"回到真实食物"，Enjoy natural food 正是这条推断的最贴文表达，且不 超过一步推。 B) 过度推断 原文只说不要靠补剂代餐、要享受真实食物的好处，从未要求 vegetarian diets（素 食）；从"少吃加工补剂"推不到"完全吃素"，跨度过大。 C) 与原文相反 全文一直在反驳"应该多吃蛋白"的舆论，Americans currently consume almost twice the National Academy of Medicine's recommended daily intake of protein 明示已 经摄入过量；选项 Consume enough protein daily 仍劝读者每天摄入足够蛋白，与作 者立场相反。 D) 与原文相反 尾段明确告诫 When we replace meals with a protein bar or drink, we also risk missing out on…——"代餐"被定性为风险行为；选项 Replace meals with protein bars 反过来把它当成建议，立场颠倒。
